news.titleEn: Houthi rebels seize Yemen's Mokha port, threatening key Red Sea shipping route as oil extends surge
news.conclusionEn: Iran-backed Houthi rebels seized Yemen's Red Sea port of Mokha and the nearby island of Mayun, extending their reach near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait as Brent crude pushed further above $100 a barrel.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装攻占也门摩卡港，逼近曼德海峡，布伦特原油续涨突破100美元。
news.whyEn: Control of chokepoints on both sides of the Arabian Peninsula raises the risk of a prolonged supply shock that could keep pushing up fuel prices, shipping costs and inflation worldwide.
news.whyZh: 若胡塞控制红海和霍尔木兹两大咽喉要道，恐长期推高全球油价、运费与通胀。
news.detailEn: The Houthis captured the port of Mokha on Thursday and the island of Mayun, also known as Perim, on Friday, marking their biggest territorial gains in years and putting Iran-aligned forces in a position to threaten both the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and the Strait of Hormuz. Saudi Arabia has increasingly routed its crude exports through the Red Sea as an alternative to Hormuz, where Iran has targeted tankers, making the advance a direct threat to global oil supply chains. Brent crude and WTI both topped $100 a barrel this week for the first time since May, with Brent later climbing toward $108 as the conflict widened. Analysts warn that a sustained disruption to either chokepoint could send oil prices significantly higher and complicate central banks' efforts to bring down inflation.
news.detailZh: 胡塞武装周四攻占摩卡港，周五又占领梅云岛（又称佩里姆岛），是其多年来最大规模的领土扩张，令亲伊朗势力有能力同时威胁曼德海峡和霍尔木兹海峡。沙特近年来日益依赖红海航线出口原油，以规避伊朗屡屡袭击油轮的霍尔木兹海峡，此次胡塞的推进因而直接威胁全球原油供应链。布伦特原油和WTI本周双双自5月以来首次突破100美元，布伦特随后一度逼近108美元，冲突不断扩大。分析师警告，若两大咽喉要道之一遭遇持续性中断，油价可能大幅走高，并令各国央行抑制通胀的努力更加复杂。

news.titleEn: US core inflation tops forecasts on record wireless price surge, cementing bets on a Fed rate hike
news.conclusionEn: US core CPI rose 0.3% in August, hotter than the 0.2% expected, driven largely by a record 5.9% jump in wireless phone service prices, pushing odds of a Fed rate hike at next week's meeting to around 90%.
news.conclusionZh: 8月核心CPI环比涨0.3%超预期，手机套餐价格创纪录暴涨，加息概率升至约90%。
news.whyEn: A hike at a Fed meeting already clouded by a slowing labor market and an active Middle East-driven energy shock would be historically unusual and would raise borrowing costs for consumers and businesses worldwide.
news.whyZh: 劳动力市场走弱叠加中东能源冲击之际加息实属罕见，将推高全球借贷成本。
news.detailEn: The consumer price index excluding food and energy climbed 0.3% from July, above the median forecast of 0.2%, while headline CPI rose 0.4% for the month. Economists at Bank of America, Barclays and Pantheon Macroeconomics pointed to a 5.9% monthly jump in wireless telephone service prices, the largest on record, as carriers like AT&T and T-Mobile changed pricing plans. The surprise, on top of an already-hot August producer price report, pushed traders' implied odds of a quarter-point Fed rate hike at the Sept. 16 meeting to around 90%, up sharply from about 56% just days earlier. The report leaves the Fed weighing a hike against signs of a cooling labor market and surging oil prices tied to the Middle East conflict, a combination some economists call an unusually difficult policy setup.
news.detailZh: 剔除食品和能源的核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，高于市场预期的0.2%，整体CPI环比上涨0.4%。美国银行、巴克莱和Pantheon宏观经济咨询公司的经济学家指出，无线电话服务价格单月暴涨5.9%，创历史纪录，原因是AT&T、T-Mobile等运营商调整了套餐定价。这一意外数据叠加此前已偏热的8月PPI报告，令交易员对9月16日会议加息25个基点的隐含概率骤升至约90%，远高于几天前的约56%。该报告令美联储需要在劳动力市场降温迹象与中东冲突推高的油价之间权衡加息决策，部分经济学家称这是一种罕见的两难政策局面。

news.titleEn: Oracle tops earnings estimates as cloud infrastructure revenue surges 121%, backlog swells to $664 billion
news.conclusionEn: Oracle beat Wall Street's fiscal first-quarter estimates, posting $1.92 adjusted earnings per share on $19.35 billion in revenue as its cloud infrastructure business surged and its remaining performance backlog hit $664 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 甲骨文季度业绩超预期，云基础设施收入暴涨121%，积压订单达6640亿美元。
news.whyEn: The results confirm that AI-driven cloud demand remains extremely strong even as capital spending soars, making Oracle a bellwether for how far the broader AI infrastructure buildout still has to run.
news.whyZh: 业绩证实AI驱动的云需求依然强劲，甲骨文成为观察AI基建投资热潮走向的风向标。
news.detailEn: Oracle reported adjusted earnings of $1.92 per share on revenue of $19.35 billion, both ahead of analyst estimates of $1.74 and $19.14 billion. Cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubled to $7.4 billion, up 121% year over year, while the company's remaining performance obligations, a measure of future contracted revenue, jumped to $664 billion. Capital expenditures soared to $28.5 billion for the quarter, more than triple year-ago levels, as Oracle raced to build out data center capacity, delivering 850 megawatts of new capacity in the period. For fiscal 2027, Oracle guided to at least $90 billion in revenue and $8.10 in adjusted earnings per share, underscoring management's confidence that AI-related cloud demand will keep accelerating.
news.detailZh: 甲骨文本季度调整后每股收益1.92美元，营收193.5亿美元，均超分析师预期的1.74美元和191.4亿美元。云基础设施收入同比暴涨121%，达到74亿美元；衡量未来合同收入的「剩余履约义务」（RPO）跃升至6640亿美元。本季度资本支出飙升至285亿美元，是去年同期的三倍多，公司正加速扩建数据中心，期内新增850兆瓦容量。甲骨文对2027财年的指引为营收至少900亿美元、调整后每股收益8.10美元，显示管理层对AI相关云需求持续加速的信心。

news.titleEn: Microsoft plans to triple data center capacity to 38 gigawatts by 2032 as Pentagon weighs $5 billion supply-chain loan
news.conclusionEn: Microsoft is planning to expand its global data center capacity from about 12 gigawatts today to more than 38 gigawatts by 2032, as the Pentagon separately opens talks on a $5 billion loan to shore up the US data-center supply chain.
news.conclusionZh: 微软计划到2032年将数据中心容量扩至38吉瓦，五角大楼拟提供50亿美元供应链贷款。
news.whyEn: The scale of the buildout, larger than New York state's peak power use, shows how severe AI-driven capacity shortages have become and how deeply national security priorities are now tied to commercial cloud infrastructure.
news.whyZh: 该扩建规模超纽约州用电峰值，反映AI算力短缺之严重及云基建与国家安全的深度绑定。
news.detailEn: Microsoft aims to more than triple its data center footprint from roughly 12 gigawatts today to over 38 gigawatts by 2032, spanning owned and leased facilities, according to people familiar with the matter. AI-specific chip capacity, currently about 2 gigawatts, is expected to grow to roughly a third of the total by 2032. The expansion follows severe hardware constraints that recently forced Microsoft to turn away some cloud and AI customers and restrict certain subscriptions. Separately, the Pentagon has opened talks on a roughly $5 billion loan aimed at preventing bottlenecks in the broader US data-center supply chain, underscoring how AI infrastructure has become a matter of national strategic concern alongside commercial competition.
news.detailZh: 据知情人士透露，微软计划将其全球数据中心容量从目前约12吉瓦扩大至2032年的38吉瓦以上，涵盖自建和租赁设施，规模扩大逾三倍。目前约2吉瓦容量专用于AI芯片，到2032年这一占比预计将升至总容量的三分之一左右。此次扩建源于此前严重的硬件产能瓶颈，曾迫使微软拒绝部分云计算和AI客户、并限制某些订阅服务。另外，五角大楼已就一笔约50亿美元的贷款展开谈判，旨在防止美国数据中心供应链出现瓶颈，凸显AI基础设施已不仅是商业竞争议题，也成为国家战略关切。

news.titleEn: US-Canada trade war threatens to unravel decades-old auto supply chain
news.conclusionEn: Escalating US-Canada tariffs, including Canada's new duties on over 700 American products and doubled 50% tariffs on steel and aluminum, are straining a deeply integrated auto supply chain that has operated almost tariff-free for decades.
news.conclusionZh: 美加关税战升级，加拿大对700余种美国商品加税，冲击两国融合数十年的汽车供应链。
news.whyEn: Auto parts often cross the US-Canada border multiple times during production, so stacked tariffs raise costs for automakers and smaller suppliers alike, with the risk of higher vehicle prices and job losses on both sides.
news.whyZh: 汽车零部件常多次跨境加工，叠加关税推高整车厂和零部件商成本，恐推升车价并波及就业。
news.detailEn: Canada's retaliatory tariffs, which took effect Sept. 8, impose 15%, 25% or 50% duties on more than 700 American goods, including doubling levies on steel and aluminum to 50%, in a package valued at roughly $20 billion meant to match US tariffs dollar for dollar. Because auto components can cross the US-Canada border several times before final assembly, each crossing can now trigger additional duties, compounding costs throughout the supply chain. Large automakers are weighing whether to redesign supply chains for the long term or absorb higher costs in the short term, while smaller parts suppliers, which typically operate on thinner margins, face a more immediate financial squeeze. The dispute threatens a cross-border manufacturing system built up over decades under free-trade arrangements, with no resolution currently in sight.
news.detailZh: 加拿大9月8日起生效的反制关税对700余种美国商品加征15%、25%或50%不等的关税，其中钢铁和铝关税翻倍至50%，整个反制方案价值约200亿美元，旨在与美国关税等额对等。由于汽车零部件在最终组装前常需多次跨越美加边境，如今每跨境一次都可能触发新关税，令整条供应链成本层层叠加。大型汽车制造商正评估是应长期重新设计供应链，还是短期内自行消化成本上升，而利润率通常更薄的中小零部件供应商则面临更直接的资金压力。这场争端正冲击几十年来在自由贸易框架下建立起来的跨境制造体系，目前尚看不到解决迹象。

news.titleEn: Anthropic says it disrupted AI misuse attempts tied to bioweapons research and state-linked cyberattacks
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic disclosed it detected and blocked several attempts to misuse its Claude AI models for activity that could aid biological weapons development, alongside cyber operations and surveillance efforts linked to actors in China, Russia and Yemen.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic披露已拦截多起利用Claude协助生物武器研发及网络攻击的滥用行为。
news.whyEn: As AI models grow more capable, the report is a rare public look at how close real-world actors are getting to using them for catastrophic harm, and how AI companies are trying to police misuse before regulators mandate it.
news.whyZh: 该报告罕见揭示了现实中不法分子借助AI造成重大危害的接近程度及企业自我监管的努力。
news.detailEn: Anthropic's threat intelligence report covers activity it disrupted between December 2025 and August 2026 across seven categories, including biological misuse, cyber operations, influence campaigns, surveillance, conventional weapons development and fraud. One flagged case involved a user attempting to use Claude to prepare a grant application for gain-of-function research on the chikungunya virus, which the company's biological safety classifier blocked in May. The company also said it disrupted efforts to use its models to help develop drones and missile-related technology, allegedly involving actors based in China, Russia and Yemen, as well as AI-assisted surveillance and scam operations. Anthropic said it shared relevant findings with government authorities and other AI companies, part of a broader industry push toward voluntary safety disclosures as AI capabilities keep advancing.
news.detailZh: Anthropic此次发布的威胁情报报告涵盖2025年12月至2026年8月期间被其拦截的活动，涉及生物滥用、网络行动、影响力操作、监控、常规武器研发和诈骗等七大类。其中一起案例中，有用户试图利用Claude撰写涉及基孔肯雅病毒功能获得性研究的科研经费申请，公司的生物安全分类器已于5月将其拦截。公司还表示已阻止一些试图利用其模型协助研发无人机和导弹相关技术的行为，据称涉及中国、俄罗斯和也门的相关行为者，同时也拦截了利用AI进行监控和诈骗的活动。Anthropic表示已将相关发现与政府部门及其他AI公司分享，这也是整个行业在AI能力持续提升之际推动自愿性安全信息披露的举措之一。

news.titleEn: Russian strikes kill civilians in Kyiv and Pavlohrad as Moscow targets Ukraine's fuel stations and malls
news.conclusionEn: Russian drones struck gas stations in Kyiv for a second straight day and hit a shopping mall in Pavlohrad, killing at least seven people combined, as Moscow widens a campaign targeting civilian infrastructure.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军无人机连续两日袭击基辅加油站，并击中帕夫洛赫拉德商场，至少7人死亡。
news.whyEn: The intensified strikes on everyday civilian sites, rather than only military or energy targets, signal an effort to spread fear and pressure Ukrainian society as diplomatic efforts to end the war remain stalled.
news.whyZh: 袭击转向日常民生场所而非仅军事目标，意在向乌克兰社会施压，而停战外交仍陷僵局。
news.detailEn: A Russian drone strike on a gas station in Kyiv killed at least two people and wounded eight others, part of a second consecutive day of strikes on the capital's fuel stations that Ukrainian officials say is aimed at rattling civilians. In Pavlohrad, a Russian drone hit a shopping mall in broad daylight, killing five people and wounding 67 others, prompting the city to observe an official day of mourning. Ukraine's foreign minister said Russia is deliberately attacking places where civilians gather to maximize casualties and spread fear, part of a broader campaign that has also hit food distribution hubs and left some supermarket shelves bare in Kyiv. The strikes come as diplomatic efforts to end the war remain stalled, with Moscow rejecting recent truce proposals.
news.detailZh: 俄军无人机袭击基辅一处加油站，造成至少2人死亡、8人受伤，这是俄方连续第二天袭击首都加油站，乌方官员称此举意在制造民众恐慌。在帕夫洛赫拉德，一架俄军无人机在光天化日之下击中一处商场，造成5人死亡、67人受伤，该市为此举行官方哀悼日。乌克兰外长表示，俄罗斯正蓄意袭击民众聚集场所以最大化伤亡、制造恐慌，这一更广泛的行动此前还波及食品配送枢纽，一度导致基辅部分超市货架空置。此次袭击发生之际，结束战争的外交努力仍陷入僵局，莫斯科拒绝了近期的停火提议。

news.titleEn: Hong Kong court sentences Tiananmen vigil leaders to up to seven years in prison
news.conclusionEn: A Hong Kong court sentenced three former leaders of the Tiananmen vigil group to prison terms of five to more than seven years for inciting subversion under the Beijing-imposed national security law.
news.conclusionZh: 香港法院以「煽动颠覆国家政权罪」判处三名六四纪念活动组织者最高逾七年监禁。
news.whyEn: The ruling against organizers of what was once the world's largest annual Tiananmen commemoration is widely seen as a further marker of shrinking civil liberties in Hong Kong under Beijing's national security law.
news.whyZh: 此案被视为北京国安法下香港公民自由持续收缩的又一标志性事件，引发国际关注。
news.detailEn: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, former leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, were sentenced to 7 years and 7 years and 3 months respectively, while Albert Ho received 5 years and 2 months after pleading guilty. The three were convicted of inciting subversion for their roles in the Alliance, which for three decades organized the city's annual vigil marking the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown, long the only large-scale public commemoration of the event on Chinese soil. Rights groups and the United Nations condemned the sentencing, while Hong Kong's government defended the ruling as a lawful application of the national security law imposed by Beijing in 2020. The case is widely viewed as another signal of the law's continued use to dismantle organized civil society in the city.
news.detailZh: 支联会（香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会）前领导人李卓人和邹幸彤分别被判处7年及7年3个月监禁，何俊仁因认罪获判5年2个月。三人均被裁定犯有「煽动颠覆国家政权罪」，其所属的支联会三十年来一直组织本地纪念1989年天安门事件的年度烛光晚会，曾是中国境内唯一大规模的公开纪念活动。人权组织和联合国对判决表示谴责，香港政府则为此辩护，称这是对北京2020年颁布的国安法的合法适用。此案被广泛视为国安法持续被用于瓦解香港有组织公民社会的又一信号。

businessTips.explanationEn: Lagging indicators, like quarterly revenue or profit, tell you what already happened, while leading indicators, like sales pipeline activity or website sign-ups, predict what is likely to happen next. Relying only on lagging metrics means you find out about a problem only after it has already hurt the business, often too late to act. Good management systems track a small number of leading indicators that causally connect to the lagging outcome you actually care about. The skill is picking leading indicators that truly predict the result, not just ones that are easy to measure.
businessTips.explanationZh: 滞后指标（如季度营收或利润）反映已经发生的结果，而领先指标（如销售管道活跃度或网站注册量）则能预示接下来可能发生的变化。如果只盯着滞后指标，往往等发现问题时业务已经受损，为时已晚。好的管理体系会追踪少数几个与最终结果真正存在因果关系的领先指标。关键在于选出真正能预测结果的领先指标，而不是只挑容易测量的指标。
businessTips.exampleEn: A SaaS company notices monthly revenue is flat, a lagging indicator that only confirms a problem after the fact. Digging in, they find that demo requests, a leading indicator, started dropping two months earlier because a competitor cut prices. Because they also track this leading metric, they can respond immediately with a promotion, instead of waiting another quarter to notice revenue has already slipped.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家SaaS公司发现月度营收持平——这是一个滞后指标，只能在问题已发生后加以确认。深入排查后发现，产品演示预约量（一个领先指标）早在两个月前就已开始下滑，原因是竞争对手降价。由于公司同时追踪这一领先指标，得以立即推出促销应对，而不必再等一个季度才发现营收已经下滑。

businessTips.explanationEn: A productized service takes a custom, hourly freelance offering and repackages it as a fixed-scope, fixed-price package, similar to buying a product off a shelf rather than commissioning custom work. This makes the offer easier to sell because customers instantly understand what they get and what it costs, and it makes delivery easier to systematize, delegate or eventually automate. It trades some flexibility and per-client customization for scalability and predictable margins, since you are no longer trading hours for dollars in an open-ended way. Many successful one-person and small-team businesses grow specifically by narrowing a broad service into one repeatable, well-defined package.
businessTips.explanationZh: 所谓「产品化服务」，是把按小时收费的定制型自由职业服务，重新包装成范围固定、价格固定的标准套餐，就像购买一件现成商品，而不是委托一项定制工作。这样一来，客户能立刻明白自己花多少钱能得到什么，服务更容易卖出去；同时交付流程也更容易标准化、外包甚至日后自动化。代价是牺牲了部分灵活性和针对个别客户的定制空间，换来的是可规模化和更可预测的利润率，因为你不再是无限期地拿时间换钱。很多成功的个人或小团队生意，恰恰是通过把宽泛的服务收窄成一个可重复交付的明确套餐而实现增长的。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance web designer who used to quote every project individually by estimated hours instead creates a fixed $3,000 'five-page business website' package with a clearly defined scope and two-week turnaround. Clients can now say yes without a lengthy back-and-forth negotiation, and because the scope is fixed, the designer can eventually train an assistant to handle parts of the work using a repeatable checklist. Revenue becomes more predictable, and the business is no longer capped purely by the designer's own available hours.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由网页设计师原本每个项目都按预估工时单独报价，后来改为推出一款固定3000美元的「五页企业官网」套餐，范围明确、两周交付。客户现在无需反复议价便可直接下单；由于服务范围固定，设计师后续还能培训助理，按照可重复的清单流程分担部分工作。营收因此变得更可预测，业务规模也不再单纯受限于设计师个人的可用工时。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration measures how sensitive a bond's price is to changes in interest rates; roughly speaking, a bond with a duration of 7 years will lose about 7% of its value if rates rise by 1 percentage point, and gain about 7% if rates fall by 1 point. Longer-maturity bonds generally have higher duration, meaning their prices swing more sharply than short-term bonds when yields move. This is why a rising-rate environment, like one driven by hot inflation data or a hawkish central bank, can cause real losses in a bond portfolio even though the bonds haven't defaulted. Investors who need to sell before maturity are far more exposed to this risk than those who can simply hold a bond to maturity and collect its stated interest.
businessTips.explanationZh: 久期用来衡量债券价格对利率变化的敏感程度：大致而言，久期为7年的债券，若利率上升1个百分点，价格约下跌7%；利率下降1个百分点，价格则约上涨7%。期限越长的债券久期通常越高，意味着收益率变动时其价格波动也更剧烈。这正是为什么在通胀数据偏热或央行立场趋鹰、利率上升的环境下，即便债券本身并未违约，债券组合也可能出现实实在在的账面亏损。相比能够持有到期、按票面利率收取利息的投资者，需要在到期前卖出债券的投资者要承担大得多的这类风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor holds a 10-year Treasury bond when the 10-year yield jumps from about 4.5% to nearly 5% on hot inflation data and rising Fed rate-hike odds, similar to the recent move to almost 4.95%. Because the bond has a duration of roughly 8 years, its market price falls by around 4%, even though the bond will still pay its full face value if held to maturity. An investor who needs the cash now must sell at a loss, while one who can hold until maturity avoids that loss entirely and simply collects the original coupon.
